about: Owner 2026-10-22, live iPhone: "When do me a picture of a dog in this chat right now" went to the model, which printed a fake dalle.text2im tool call as JSON instead of a picture. A picture request in everyday words goes to the picture engine; a model reply that is a pretend picture-tool call is never shown as text.
